description: Bulk company lookup: run one tool (tech stack, open jobs, hiring intent, Google Ads or company profile) on many domains with one payment. Step 1 (free): send {tool, domains}; every domain is checked and you get each status plus a quote_id priced only for rows with data. Step 2: send {quote_id} and pay the exact quoted amount via x402 on Base to receive all rows. Max $1 per call: up to 50 domains, or 33 for company-profile. Rows without data are never charged. Quotes last 15 minutes; 3 free scans per day per IP.

domains.description: Public company domains without a URL scheme, path or port.

quote_id.description: quote_id from step 1. Send it alone to pay and receive the results.

name: batch_lookup

cold.description: hot-buyers: domains below the threshold, free.

status.description: quote: pay with quote_id to get the results. nothing_billable: no charge. ok: paid results.
